items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: The first is the sorting of the dross found in his MAN, which ascend from BYA, and this is done by Abba, in the secret of the 32 paths of Hochma. The second is the sweetening of the bottom Hey in the first Hey, in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, and this is done by the five Gevurot of Ima, in which ZA is included at the time of his mingling in the coupling of Ima. See above in answer 17. (Page 958, Sub Header, “and with”).
